messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@tempo.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: technical demo — quickstart feedback

Hi Soojin,

Tried the Quickstart guide this morning (nice work — very clear). I spun up a basic flow to evaluate latency and token costs and have a few follow-ups where we'd like to dig into:

- routing policies when we have multi-tenant models
- recommended quantization profiles for cost targets
- prefix caching behavior for streaming workloads

We're a small infra team building an ML infra layer for Tempo AI; I have developer intent here and would appreciate a short technical demo (not a sales deck) with someone who can walk through runtime/ops and config.

Available windows today: 10:30–12:30 PT or after 16:00 PT. If none of those work, I can flex.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Senior ML Engineer, Tempo AI
samir@tempo.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Samir —

Thanks for trying the Quickstart and for the notes — glad it was clear. Happy to set up a technical session focused on runtime/ops and the specific items you listed. I've looped in Dev (engineering) so we can dive into kernel/runtime behaviour and config.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Today 10:45–11:15
- Today 11:30–12:00
- Monday 09:00–09:30

You can pick a time via our Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-technical-demo or tell me which of the above works and I’ll send an invite.

Agenda (draft):
1) Quick context on your test runs (5m)
2) Runtime behaviours: batching, KV/prefix caching (10m)
3) Quantization and perf knobs for cost targets (10m)
4) Action items and follow-ups (5m)

I've attached a short agenda and included the logs you sent. If there's a specific file or trace you'd like us to look at, attach it and we can pull it into the call.

Cheers,
So

Thanks for confirming. I’ll lead the technical portion. Quick notes ahead of the call:

- We’ll allocate 30 minutes and aim to hit your three bullets: routing policies, quantization guidance, and prefix caching behaviour.
- If you can share the specific model architecture and sequence lengths you tested (or attach a short trace), that’ll help us reproduce the behaviour quickly.
- For SSO/audit retention: Laura (cc) is our security/product ops lead and can answer retention and audit log defaults; we can go over high-level options during the call and follow up with doc links.
